Title: New standard tier performance levels in Azure SQL Database

Body.Content:
New standard performance levels S4, S6, S7, S9, and S12 for single databases are now generally available. These new performance levels are well-suited for CPU intensive workloads that don't require the IO performance provided by the premium tier.

Learn more about these new standard tier performance levels at the Azure blog.
